name: website_hero
title: NEXUS X1 - Futuristic Product Hero with 3D

overview.description: A premium, futuristic hero section showcasing a 3D football boot product with advanced Three.js rendering, dynamic lighting, energy rings, custom cursor, loading animation, and real-time color customization. Features ACES Filmic tone mapping, particle effects, and smooth UI animations powered by GSAP.
overview.purpose: Creates a high-end, immersive product showcase for modern e-commerce, sports brands, or tech products. Demonstrates cutting-edge web 3D capabilities with production-ready features like loading states, color variants, and responsive design.
overview.useCase: Product launch pages, e-commerce hero sections, sports brand websites, luxury product showcases, tech product reveals, sneaker websites

visualEffects: 3D GLB model with realistic lighting and shadows
Cinematic ACES Filmic tone mapping for film-like colors
Mouse parallax effect on product rotation
Two energy rings rotating in opposite directions
Dynamic color system (4 colorways: Phantom, Inferno, Volt, Obsidian)
Real-time light color changes synchronized with product
Loading screen with animated progress bar

keyFeatures: Particle fallback if model fails to load
Multi-light setup (ambient, key, fill, rim, point)
Dynamic color system with CSS variable sync
GSAP intro animation with ease curves

lighting.key: Directional at (5,5,5) - main light with color tint
lighting.point: PointLight at (2,0,2) with 10 unit range - product glow

colorSystem.synchronization: Lights, rings, particles, and CSS variables all update together

updates: Active state on color selector buttons

loadingSystem.loader: Fixed fullscreen overlay with NEXUS branding
loadingSystem.progressBar: Animated width based on GLTFLoader progress (xhr.loaded/xhr.total)

fallback.action: If model not loaded, call createParticleFallback()
fallback.fallbackContent: 3000 particles arranged in shoe-like shape (spherical formations)

distribution: 50% - Main shoe body: spherical distribution (1.5x, 0.5y, 0.7z scale)
30% - Toe area: smaller sphere offset to x:+1.8, y:-0.3
particleFallback.purpose: Ensures site works even if model fails to load

energyRings.purpose: Adds sci-fi aesthetic, frames product, indicates interactivity

customCursor.positioning: Follows mousemove with direct x/y translation
customCursor.effect: Creates ambient glow around cursor, enhances futuristic feel

introSequence: Loading screen fades out (300ms after model loads)
Nav, hero content, product info fade in with 'visible' class
Scroll indicator, social proof, color selector appear
uiAnimations.transitions: CSS transitions for hover states, color changes
uiAnimations.easing: GSAP power2.out for smooth, natural deceleration

htmlStructure.loader: Fixed fullscreen with logo, bar, text
htmlStructure.nav: Fixed top navigation with logo, links, CTA
htmlStructure.hero: Main content area with left-aligned text

cssArchitecture.gradients: Extensive use of linear and radial gradients

parameters.name: Model Position
parameters.default: { x: 1.5, y: 0, z: 0 } - right side of screen

addingColors.step1: Add to CONFIG.colors with primary + secondary hex

optimizations: Model loading with progress (prevents blank screen)
Efficient animation loop (only updates changed values)

metrics.dependencies: Three.js (~600 KB), GSAP (~50 KB) from CDN
metrics.FPS: 60 FPS on modern GPUs, 30-45 on integrated

considerations: GLB model size directly affects load time
Complex models (>10K vertices) may impact mobile FPS
ACES tone mapping adds ~5ms per frame (negligible)
Custom cursor uses GPU for blur filter

requirements.cssFit: backdrop-filter for glassmorphism (fallback needed for older browsers)

fallbacks.webgl: No explicit fallback (would need WebGL detection + static image)
fallbacks.backdrop-filter: Could add solid background fallback for old Safari

advantages: Film-quality rendering with ACES tone mapping
Production-ready with loading states and error handling
Responsive design works on all screens
Particle fallback ensures site never breaks
limitations: Requires GLB model file (not included in repo)
Model loading can be slow on poor connections
High GPU usage may impact battery on mobile
Custom cursor may confuse some users
Auto-rotation could cause motion sickness (consider toggle)
No accessibility features for screen readers
futureEnhancements: Implement product image fallback for no-WebGL browsers
Add touch gestures for mobile rotation control
Create model viewer controls (zoom, reset, pause rotation)
Implement lazy loading for off-screen elements
Create admin panel for color customization
